### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window Bounds:** 1024x768 (Maximized, excluding Windows Taskbar).
*   **Title Bar:** [0, 0] to [1024, 50]. Contains app icon/title on left, utility icons and window controls on right.
*   **Sidebar (Navigation):** [0, 50] to [280, 940]. Vertical list with section headers and selectable items.
*   **Main Content Area:** [290, 50] to [1024, 940]. White card-like container with rounded corners and internal padding.
    *   **Header Region:** [310, 80] to [700, 180]. Title and subtitle text.
    *   **Feature List Region:** [310, 260] to [730, 720]. Vertical stack of three feature items (Icon + Title + Description).
    *   **CTA Region:** [310, 770] to [460, 820]. Primary action button.
    *   **Illustration Region:** [675, 300] to [980, 690]. Large graphical element overlapping the right side of the content area.

### 2. TEXT
*   **Title Bar:**
    *   "EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free" [25, 20]
*   **Sidebar:**
    *   "Data Recovery" [15, 105]
    *   "Hardware Disk" [65, 160]
    *   "SD Card" [65, 230]
    *   "More Recovery Tools" [65, 300]
    *   "Advanced Features" [15, 375]
    *   "File Repair" [65, 420]
    *   "Lost Partition Rescue" [65, 490]
    *   "File Backup" [15, 565]
    *   "ChronoSnap Backup" [65, 620]
*   **Main Content:**
    *   "ChronoSnap Backup Free" [310, 100]
    *   "Your free & effortless Time Machine for Windows" [310, 155]
    *   "Automatic Protection" [370, 275]
    *   "Smart, continuous backup that operates effortlessly in the background." [370, 325]
    *   "Point-in-Time Recovery" [370, 455]
    *   "Restore your files from any historical moment with ease." [370, 505]
    *   "Powerful and Independent" [370, 630]
    *   "A robust, standalone application that works smoothly within your workflow." [370, 675]
    *   "Start" [380, 790]

### 3. COLOR
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window Background: `#F0F4FA` (ESTIMATED - Light Blue-Grey)
    *   Main Content Card: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Sidebar Item Selected: `#E8F0FE` (ESTIMATED - Light Blue)
    *   Illustration Background: `#2C3142` (ESTIMATED - Dark Navy/Blue)
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Titles): `#1F1F1F` (ESTIMATED - Near Black)
    *   Secondary Text (Descriptions): `#5F6368` (ESTIMATED - Dark Grey)
    *   Sidebar Text (Unselected): `#333333`
    *   Sidebar Text (Selected): `#1A73E8` (ESTIMATED - Bright Blue)
    *   Button Text: `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Accents & Borders:**
    *   Primary Button Background: `#1677FF` (ESTIMATED - Standard Windows Blue)
    *   Selection Indicator (Left Bar): `#1677FF`
    *   Success Checkmark: `#34A853` (ESTIMATED - Green)
    *   Illustration Accents: `#4A90E2` (Light Blue lines), `#FFD700` (Yellow star/hat), `#8AB4F8` (Light blue folder).

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Window Title:** Segoe UI / System Font, ~11px, Regular.
*   **Sidebar Headers:** Segoe UI, ~12px, Regular, Grey.
*   **Sidebar Items:** Segoe UI, ~13px, Regular.
*   **Main Heading ("ChronoSnap..."):** Segoe UI / Custom Sans, ~24px-28px, Semi-Bold.
*   **Subheading ("Your free..."):** Segoe UI, ~14px, Regular, Grey.
*   **Feature Titles:** Segoe UI, ~16px, Semi-Bold.
*   **Feature Descriptions:** Segoe UI, ~13px, Regular, Line height ~1.5.
*   **Button Text:** Segoe UI, ~14px, Medium/Bold.

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Sidebar Width:** ~280px.
*   **Content Padding:** ~40px left/right, ~50px top/bottom.
*   **Feature Item Spacing:** ~90px vertical gap between items.
*   **Feature Icon Size:** ~48x48px container.
*   **Button Dimensions:** ~150px width x ~44px height.
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Main Content Card: ~12px.
    *   Button: ~6px.
    *   Illustration Container: ~16px.
    *   Sidebar Selection Highlight: ~6px (on corners).
*   **Icon Margins:** Icons in sidebar are ~16px from left edge; Text starts at ~55px from left edge.

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Window Controls (Top Right):** Minimize, Maximize/Restore, Close. State: Normal.
*   **Utility Icons (Top Right):**
    *   Cloud/Update icon (Blue badge).
    *   Shopping Cart icon (Orange).
    *   Bell/Notification icon.
    *   Hamburger Menu icon.
*   **Sidebar List Items:**
    *   "Hardware Disk": Normal state + Green Checkmark Badge (Success/Active).
    *   "ChronoSnap Backup": **Selected State** (Blue left border strip, light blue background, blue text).
    *   Others: Normal state.
*   **Primary Button ("Start"):** Normal state (Solid fill). Likely hover/active states exist but not shown.

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Outline/Filled hybrid (mostly outline with colored accents).
*   **Sidebar Icons:**
    *   Hardware Disk: Grid/Square icon.
    *   SD Card: SD Card shape icon.
    *   More Tools: Wrench/Screwdriver crossed.
    *   File Repair: Folder with tool.
    *   Lost Partition: Globe/Search.
    *   ChronoSnap: Circular arrow/Refresh style with blue center.
*   **Feature Icons:**
    *   Auto Protection: Folders with circular arrow.
    *   Point-in-Time: Folder with clock/play triangle.
    *   Powerful: Code brackets `</>` with gear.
*   **Illustration:** Complex vector illustration containing a folder, shield, robot/mascot character, and abstract data waves.

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Static/Landing**. This is a feature landing page or "empty state" prompting the user to begin an action ("Start"). No loading spinners or error messages are visible.
*   **Context:** The user has navigated to the "ChronoSnap Backup" section of the "EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard". The presence of the green checkmark on "Hardware Disk" suggests that feature might be active or configured, while ChronoSnap is currently being viewed but not yet started.
